name: pair-coach
description: Talk to Claude through the code itself: write a // @coach comment to ask a question or give an instruction, and Claude answers inline, makes the change, or asks you back, addressed to you by your own git name. /pair-coach:pair builds a task and hands you the few lines that are genuinely your call, as stubs that fail loudly until you write them. Ships two skills, one zero-dependency parser, and one prompt hook that only reads lines you wrote. Touches neither memory nor the engine.
